_comment: Per-sweep wall-clock budgets. Spans measured by the doskutsu session from rounds M/N/O (POD-83, Am5x86, DX2-66, DX2-50) and I/J/K (DX2-66). Timeouts are ~2x the slowest machine. Duration is a function of cell count and CPU, near-independent of what the cells do: cells are tick-driven against a fixed QA.TAS reel, so wall-clock is set by tick count, not by the code under test.

denied.RECORD: TAS reel recording tool. Has TWO PAUSE calls because a human plays the route being recorded. An autonomous runner would hang at the second one.
denied.VB: Listening sweep. Prints 'listen for X' and depends on a human judging audio. Capture can detect silence but cannot judge correctness.
denied.EAR: Listening sweep, same reasoning as VB.
